technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring's existing module system and configuration mechanisms for customization.
Leverage Kafka's native encoder/decoder APIs for U1.
Implement gpfdist sink using GPDB's GPFDIST protocol for U2.
Integrate Flo with Spring XD's admin UI using REST APIs for U3.
Use Spring's Tasklet API for file reading and gpload operations (U5, U6).
Refactor classpath loading to use modular dependencies for U7 and U8.

GPFDIST and gpload libraries are available for integration.
Existing Spring XD modules can be extended without major architectural changes.
UI infrastructure for Flo and admin_ui can be integrated via standard Spring components.
Hadoop dependencies are modularized and can be decoupled without breaking existing functionality.

Validate data ingestion performance and correctness with GPDB/HAWQ.
